infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We need microphone access so you can record a voice note describing the job you just finished.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need camera access so you can photograph the job site for documentation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need photo library access so you can attach an existing photo to job documentation.
